row.notes: Builds one R&D department tab page (called from 0x141c7b3d0). rsi = the 0x950 dept card: dept = byte [card+0x6d8], team = dword [card+0x6bc], per-team Upgrades model = [card+0x688]. @0x141c7d8cf calls Career_Query_EnabledUpgrades(U, out=rsp+0xdf0, &team=rsp+0x8c, 0xffff) and keeps results whose byte [u+0x72] == the card dept; @0x141c7dcb5 reads Career_Get_TeamModifiers for the research-slot count. Department-4 pages are empty because dept-4 instances are never enabled (rnd_ui.md#instances), not because this builder refuses 4.
